Crime & Law · India

Multiple alleged scams and exam irregularities reported across India

Several reports detail alleged scams and irregularities in various sectors across India. In Delhi, top health officials have been arrested in connection with a procurement scam, with the ED joining the probe. Meanwhile, exam centres in Jaipur and other locations have seen chaos and allegations of paper leaks and cheating rackets, leading to cancellations and arrests. Investigations into these incidents are ongoing.
